RSMSSB Paramedical Staff Online Form 2025 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the short notice for the post of Paramedical Staff. This recruitment has been issued for 2626 posts. Online applying process for RSMSSB Paramedical Staff Recruitment 2025 will be started from 18 February 2025 & the candidates can apply till 19 March 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for RSMSSB Paramedical Staff Recruitment 2025 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date : 12 December 2024
  • Application Start Date : 18 February 2025
  • Last Date : 19 March 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 19 March 2025
  • Correction Date : Available Soon
  • Exam Date : Notified Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC (Creamy Layer) : Rs. 600/-
  • EWS , OBC (Non Creamy Layer) : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

  • Apply Online
  • Official Website
